item.title: El presidente chino Xi podría visitar India por primera vez en siete años
item.description: Es probable que el presidente chino, Xi Jinping, asista a la cumbre del BRICS del próximo mes en Nueva Delhi acompañado de una nutrida delegación, según tres fuentes, en lo que sería su primera visita en siete años y una nueva señal del deshielo en las relaciones entre ambos rivales.
item.dc:creator: Saurabh Sharma, Aftab Ahmed
item.content:encoded: Es probable que el presidente chino, Xi Jinping, asista a la cumbre del BRICS del próximo mes en Nueva Delhi acompañado de una nutrida delegación, según tres fuentes, en lo que sería su primera visita en siete años y una nueva señal del deshielo en las relaciones entre ambos rivales. India acogerá la cumbre del 12 al 13 de septiembre, donde la presencia de Xi será objeto de atención no tanto por la agenda del BRICS como por lo que signifique respecto a los esfuerzos de Pekín y Nueva Delhi por estabilizar las relaciones tras los mortíferos enfrentamientos fronterizos de 2020. "Los funcionarios chinos están ocupados ultimando los detalles sobre los hoteles y los protocolos de seguridad", declaró a Reuters una de las fuentes indias con conocimiento directo del asunto. El año pasado, el primer ministro indio, Narendra Modi, visitó China por primera vez en siete años, pero la relación solo ha mejorado gradualmente. Más recientemente, una nueva disputa relacionada con la frontera desencadenó un duro intercambio diplomático entre ambas partes. Otras dos fuentes indias indicaron que era probable que Xi estuviera acompañado por una delegación de unos 400 funcionarios, frente a los menos de 200 de la última visita, en 2019. Se espera que los responsables de ambos países aprovechen la cumbre para explorar formas de ampliar la colaboración, al tiempo que gestionan las diferencias de larga data sobre la frontera y las cuestiones de seguridad regional, añadieron las fuentes. Los planes definitivos de viaje de Xi y la agenda para cualquier posible reunión bilateral entre India y China aún no se han concretado, indicaron las fuentes. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores chino dijo: "China concede gran importancia a la cooperación del BRICS y participa activamente en ella, y apoya a India, actualmente en la presidencia, para que organice con éxito la cumbre del BRICS de este año". "Por el momento no disponemos de información que podamos facilitar" sobre la visita de Xi, añadió. Xi no asistió a la última cumbre del BRICS, celebrada en 2025 en Brasil. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de India no hizo comentarios al respecto. LA CUESTIÓN FRONTERIZA ENTRE INDIA Y CHINA Los dos países más poblados del mundo, ambos potencias nucleares, comparten una frontera de aproximadamente 3.800 kilómetros en el Himalaya, en gran parte sin delimitar y objeto de disputa. Décadas de relativa paz a lo largo de la frontera se vieron truncadas por los enfrentamientos de 2020, en los que murieron 20 soldados indios y cuatro chinos. El incidente dio lugar a un enfrentamiento militar que se prolongó cuatro años, hasta que se alcanzó un pacto de retirada en octubre de 2024. Sin embargo, el 12 de agosto, India afirmó que la paz a lo largo de la frontera era fundamental para las relaciones entre ambos países, tras conocerse que patrullas de los ejércitos indio y chino se habían encontrado cara a cara a finales de julio cerca de un tramo remoto de la frontera. El asesor de Seguridad Nacional de India, Ajit Doval, inició este lunes su visita a Pekín para reunirse con el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores chino, Wang Yi, y mantener conversaciones sobre la cuestión fronteriza. Aunque India y China siguen siendo rivales, las políticas comerciales del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, han creado un punto de convergencia, lo que hace que la asistencia de Xi sea una señal de que ninguna de las partes quiere que la presión externa socave el BRICS. (1 dólar = 95,7450 rupias indias)

item.title: MERCADOS ARGENTINOS ¿Qué dicen los analistas? Semana del 24 al 28 de agosto
item.description: Los mercados financieros de Argentina inician la semana con la mirada de los inversores en el desarrollo del mercado cambiario local y en cómo seguirá el riesgo país, el indicador elaborado por el JPMorgan, tras su importante suba del último tiempo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los mercados financieros de Argentina inician la semana con la mirada de los inversores en el desarrollo del mercado cambiario local y en cómo seguirá el riesgo país, el indicador elaborado por el JPMorgan, tras su importante suba del último tiempo. Los inversores también esperan el resultado de la última licitación de títulos del mes del Ministerio de Economía hacia el cierre de la semana. Analistas y operadores opinan sobre la coyuntura doméstica: * "La estabilidad cambiaria se ha logrado triplicando las ventas de divisas a término hacia el nivel de 12.000 millones de dólares y eso que recién comienzan las pujas políticas para las elecciones presidenciales del año próximo", expresó la consultora Vatnet. * "Desde el 7 de julio, el riesgo país argentino subió 103 puntos, de 403 a 506 puntos básicos. No fue un solo factor: fue una sucesión. El contexto internacional empezó a jugar en contra" y "se sumó un dato local: los superávits gemelos dejaron de sorprender (...).Lo que antes era noticia hoy es piso: sin la macro no se puede, pero con la macro sola ya no alcanza", dijo GMA Capital Research. Y añadió que "mientras tanto, la micro empezó a robarse la atención: la actividad no logró compensar las caídas previas, los salarios acumulan una baja real en el semestre y la mora crece en un universo de votantes oficialistas que, según nuestras estimaciones, representa 12,6% del electorado de La Libertad Avanza" * "Los activos argentinos lograron cortar una racha negativa de 14 ruedas consecutivas al alza en el indicador de riesgo. Apoyados en un rebote técnico de la deuda soberana en dólares y compras en el sector bancario" afirmó IOL inversiones. * "Los inversores no logran despegarse de la cautela que vino prevaleciendo en los últimos tiempos a partir de una mayor sensibilidad al ruido político y al humor social. En dicho sentido, serán importantes los próximos índices de confianza a fin de actualizar el panorama, así como que se pueda ir dejando atrás la volatilidad de las tasas en pesos que afecta al crédito" dijo el economista Gustavo Ber. * "Desde comienzos de agosto se observa que el banco central compra menos en el mercado único y libre de cambio (MULC) y por otro lado se tienen tasas de corto plazo algo más altas y volátiles que en meses anteriores", explicó Roberto Geretto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero. "De ese modo, la contra-cara de defender el dólar en 1.500 pesos es un mercado de bonos en pesos también con mayores tasas y volatilidad, lo cual de continuar encarece el costo de fondeo para el Tesoro y la economía en general. Así, el trade off entre inflación y actividad con acumulación de reservas se hace más presente", agregó. * La actividad industrial de julio registró una "contracción mensual de 0,4%", mientras que su variación interanual anotó una mejora de "0,7%, impulsada por la actividad en refinerías, metálicas básicas, química y alimentos, mientras que plásticos, textiles, maquinaria y equipo y minerales no metálicos tuvieron la mayor incidencia negativa", según un informe de la consultora Orlando Ferreres & Asociados.

item.title: Jefe de equipo de McLaren dice que Norris está mostrando más confianza en sí mismo
item.description: El jefe del equipo McLaren, Andrea Stella, afirmó que Lando Norris está demostrando más confianza en sí mismo y que sus resultados lo están recompensando.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: El jefe del equipo McLaren, Andrea Stella, afirmó que Lando Norris está demostrando más confianza en sí mismo y que sus resultados lo están recompensando. El vigente campeón de Fórmula 1 ganó el domingo el Gran Premio de los Países Bajos desde la pole position, su segunda victoria consecutiva y la decimotercera de su carrera, pero tuvo que ganarla adelantando al Mercedes del líder del campeonato, Kimi Antonelli, tras perder el liderato en una reanudación de la carrera. El británico sigue a 83 puntos del líder, pero está recortando poco a poco la diferencia. "Diría que, sin duda, ahora está mostrando un mayor nivel de asertividad", declaró Stella a los periodistas en Zandvoort. "Creo que la maniobra para adelantar a Antonelli es una demostración realmente buena de ello. Está mostrando más confianza en sí mismo". "Esto es interesante y me gusta bastante; a veces, la confianza en uno mismo no se demuestra siendo el más agresivo. A veces tienes confianza en ti mismo cuando piensas algo así como: '¿Sabes qué? No voy a enzarzarme en una lucha ahora mismo porque podría salir perdiendo. Es una carrera muy larga, nos vemos al final'", agregó. Stella explicó que eso implica tener la confianza necesaria para dar un paso atrás, al tiempo que se mantiene la fe en poder salir adelante a largo plazo. Señaló que, tanto en Hungría como en Países Bajos, Norris había perdido la ventaja de la pole, pero no su confianza. "Creo que la asertividad y la confianza son probablemente las dos características en las que más ha mejorado desde un punto de vista no técnico y no operativo», añadió Stella. Norris ha afirmado que los autos de nueva generación son difíciles de pilotar y que ha tenido que adaptar su estilo para hacer frente a ello. También se atribuyó gran parte del mérito de la victoria del domingo, señalando que un piloto aún puede marcar la diferencia. Stella coincidió en que el británico está pilotando como un campeón y mejorando constantemente, un proceso que comenzó a principios de 2025, cuando "algo encajó". "Creo que este enfoque ha llevado a Lando a mejorar continuamente. Es casi como si viera a Lando cada vez más fuerte carrera tras carrera", comentó. Por su parte, su compañero de equipo, el australiano Oscar Piastri, lleva un año sin ganar una carrera, desde que se impuso desde la pole en Zandvoort el pasado agosto. El domingo acabó sexto, a 32 segundos de Norris y lastrado por una parada en boxes lenta que le costó una posición en una tarde frustrante. Stella afirmó que el resultado no refleja fielmente la competitividad de Piastri a lo largo del fin de semana de carreras sprint.

item.title: Tesouro dos EUA deve ampliar escopo de sanções secundárias contra Irã, diz fonte
item.description: O Departamento do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos deve ampliar o escopo das sanções secundárias que pode impor a entidades e países que mantêm laços comerciais com o Irã, à medida que o governo do presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, busca, nesta segunda-feira, aumentar a pressão econômica sobre Teerã, informou à Reuters uma fonte a par dos planos.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder
item.content:encoded: O Departamento do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos deve ampliar o escopo das sanções secundárias que pode impor a entidades e países que mantêm laços comerciais com o Irã, à medida que o governo do presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, busca, nesta segunda-feira, aumentar a pressão econômica sobre Teerã, informou à Reuters uma fonte a par dos planos. A medida visa dar um aviso final aos países para que rompam seus laços comerciais com o Irã, em um esforço para forçar o fim do conflito de quase seis meses que tem bloqueado o Estreito de Ormuz e as exportações de energia do Golfo Pérsico, disse a fonte, que falou sob condição de anonimato por não estar autorizada a se pronunciar publicamente sobre o assunto. Espera-se que o secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, anuncie mais detalhes sobre as medidas contra o Irã nesta segunda-feira, em uma coletiva de imprensa às 14h (horário de Brasília). A fonte disse que Bessent também pretende apresentar uma visão geral mais ampla da campanha de pressão econômica contra o Irã — que ele e Trump descreveram como um “Dia D econômico” — e deixará claro aos países que eles devem se aliar aos EUA ou correrão o risco de ter empresas e entidades importantes excluídas do sistema financeiro baseado no dólar. (Reportagem de David Lawder)

item.title: Ganfeng Lithium y Lithium Argentina forman nueva empresa para desarrollar Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes
item.description: Ganfeng Lithium anunció el lunes en un comunicado que su consejo de administración acordó que GFL International (Ganfeng International) y Lithium Argentina (LAR) desarrollarán en conjunto la cuenta de salinas de Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes en Argentina.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ganfeng Lithium (002460.SZ) anunció el lunes en un comunicado que su consejo de administración acordó que GFL International (Ganfeng International) y Lithium Argentina (LAR) desarrollarán en conjunto la cuenta de salinas de Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes en Argentina. La empresa informó que esto lo logrará mediante la integración del proyecto PPG (propiedad 100% de la compañía), el proyecto de litio PG (de propiedad conjunta) y el proyecto de Sal de la Puna en Millennial, que tras la integración se denominará Proyecto de Salinas de Litio PPGS. "Ganfeng International y LAR han firmado una serie de acuerdos clave para el desarrollo conjunto del proyecto de litio PPGS. Ambas partes han acordado integrar el proyecto PPGS en Millennial", dijo la firma en el comunicado, donde aclaró que se prevé que la integración se complete a fines del tercer trimestre de 2026. "Una vez completada la integración, Ganfeng International y LAR poseerán participaciones accionariales del 67% y el 33% en Millennial, respectivamente, y mantendrán la participación accionaria en el proyecto PPGS de forma proporcional", agregó. El proyecto PPGS se construirá en tres fases, con una capacidad total de diseño de 150.000 toneladas de carbonato de litio equivalente al año, indicó la firma en el comunicado, donde informó que presentó su solicitud al Régimen de Incentivo para Grandes Inversiones (RIGI) en el primer trimestre de 2026.

item.title: Receita da PDD, dona da Temu, fica abaixo das estimativas; lucro cai por concorrência na China
item.description: A PDD Holdings , empresa chinesa especializada no comércio eletrônico, divulgou na segunda-feira um aumento de 8% na receita do segundo trimestre, resultado que ficou aquém das estimativas do mercado, já que a concorrência acirrada na China e as crescentes pressões regulatórias no exterior pesaram sobre o crescimento.
item.dc:creator: Harshita Varghese, Casey Hall
item.content:encoded: A PDD Holdings (PDD.O) , empresa chinesa especializada no comércio eletrônico, divulgou na segunda-feira um aumento de 8% na receita do segundo trimestre, resultado que ficou aquém das estimativas do mercado, já que a concorrência acirrada na China e as crescentes pressões regulatórias no exterior pesaram sobre o crescimento. A operadora de Pinduoduo na China e da Temu internacionalmente registrou receita de 112,36 bilhões de iuanes (US$15,7 bilhões) nos três meses encerrados em 30 de junho, abaixo da estimativa média dos analistas de 116,35 bilhões de iuanes, de acordo com dados da LSEG. O lucro líquido atribuível aos acionistas ordinários caiu 12%, para 27,2 bilhões de iuanes. Suas ações subiam 4,6% nas voláteis negociações pré-mercado em Nova York. A PDD concorre com Taobao e Tmall do Alibaba (9988.HK) , com JD.com (9618.HK) e com Douyin, de propriedade da ByteDance, por meio de descontos, subsídios e incentivos destinados a atrair consumidores e comerciantes. No entanto, a fraca confiança do consumidor, as preocupações com a estabilidade no emprego e uma prolongada crise no setor imobiliário têm mantido os consumidores cautelosos, alimentando uma guerra de preços em todo o setor de comércio eletrônico da China e reduzindo as margens de lucro. Os gastos dos consumidores permaneceram moderados mesmo durante o festival de compras “618” deste ano, um dos maiores eventos de vendas online da China, apesar de semanas de promoções e descontos. A PDD intensificou os gastos com logística e programas de apoio aos comerciantes para reduzir os custos de atendimento e melhorar o valor para os consumidores, o que gerou preocupações entre os investidores de que a lucratividade possa sofrer ainda mais pressão. PRESSÕES REGULATÓRIAS A Temu, por sua vez, enfrenta um escrutínio cada vez maior em alguns de seus maiores mercados internacionais. A plataforma construiu seus negócios internacionais enviando produtos de baixo custo diretamente de fornecedores chineses para consumidores no exterior, mas foi afetada pelas tarifas dos EUA sobre importações chinesas e pelo fim do tratamento de isenção de impostos para encomendas de baixo valor. Custos mais altos de remessa e conformidade forçaram alguns comerciantes a aumentar os preços, o que pode reduzir a demanda entre consumidores sensíveis ao preço nos Estados Unidos e na Europa. Produtos de comércio eletrônico de baixo valor também têm atraído escrutínio, com as remessas diminuindo nos últimos meses, à medida que mudanças nas regras comerciais e nas tarifas prejudicaram as vendas transfronteiriças. Na Europa, as autoridades intensificaram os esforços para conter o influxo de produtos baratos da China por meio de plataformas como Temu, Shein e o AliExpress, do Alibaba. A taxa recém-instituída pela União Europeia sobre pequenas encomendas importadas diretamente da China deve aumentar os custos tanto para os vendedores quanto para os consumidores, afirmam analistas do setor. Esses custos adicionais ameaçam minar a vantagem de preço da Temu e podem tornar mais difícil para a empresa sustentar o rápido crescimento internacional que ajudou a alimentar o entusiasmo dos investidores pela PDD.

item.title: India's Iran exports set to fall further due to Dubai halt, U.S. sanctions
item.description: Planned new U.S. sanctions on Iran and the UAE's halt on Tehran trade could severely disrupt Indian exports of rice, tea and pharmaceuticals to Iran, which have been largely routed through Dubai's port in recent years, Indian exporters said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Manoj Kumar, Rajendra Jadhav, Mayank Bhardwaj
item.content:encoded: Planned new U.S. sanctions on Iran and the UAE's halt on Tehran trade could severely disrupt Indian exports of rice, tea and pharmaceuticals to Iran, which have been largely routed through Dubai's port in recent years, Indian exporters said on Monday. India has been among Iran's five largest trading partners, though bilateral trade has fallen by more than 90% from its 2018/19 highs of $17 billion, with exports now limited mostly to goods exempted on humanitarian grounds. Indian exporters fear U.S. President Donald Trump's proposed "economic D-Day" [USN:L1N44J03U TEXT:"plan"], likely to be unveiled later on Monday, could further [USN:L1N43I0DN TEXT:"squeeze trade"] weakened by sanctions, banking caution and shipping constraints. The United Arab Emirates last week [USN:L6N44G0HJ TEXT:"suspended all trade"] activities, exchanges and financial transactions with Iran until further notice. "We are already seeing indications that transactions and payment mechanisms traditionally routed through the UAE are exploring alternative jurisdictions," said Dev Garg, vice president of the Indian Rice Exporters Federation, suggesting Turkey as an alternative. EXPORTERS COULD FACE HIGHER FREIGHT AND OTHER COSTS In the first half of 2026, India exported $383.11 million of rice to Iran - the second-largest overseas market for premium rice, including long-grained basmati. "Any prolonged disruption in this corridor will have a much greater bearing on the basmati industry, especially on millers and exporters in northern India than on India's overall non-basmati rice trade," Garg said. Until recently, Indian exporters typically received payment through an Indian authorised-dealer bank from a UAE trader's account - in dirhams, dollars or another permitted currency -while the trader separately collected payment from its Iranian customer through legally compliant banking channels. Indian tea exports to Iran totalled $14.34 million in the first half of 2026. Prabhat Bezboruah, a senior tea planter and former chairman of the state-run Tea Board, said sales to Iran will be affected as a lot of that goes through the UAE. There was no immediate comment from India's trade and foreign ministries. A New Delhi-based exporter said direct shipments could rise, but payment problems may worsen. Ajay Srivastava of the Global Trade Research Initiative said India's Iran trade has already fallen sharply since the previous sanctions. "We hope food and pharmaceutical products may receive exemptions, although exporters could still face higher freight, insurance and payment costs," he said. Iran's exports to India were dominated by crude oil, valued at about $707 million, with far smaller shipments of liquefied petroleum gas, apples, dates, almonds and kiwi fruit in the first six months of 2026. Officials have said crude oil imports from Iran were largely enabled by a U.S. exemption granted earlier this year, and may be difficult to sustain. ($1 = 95.7225 Indian rupees)

item.title: Mélenchon se perfila para pasar a la segunda vuelta presidencial en Francia, según un sondeo
item.description: El líder de la izquierda francés Jean-Luc Mélenchon aparece como el rival más probable de la candidata de extrema derecha Marine Le Pen en la segunda vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales del próximo año, según un sondeo publicado el lunes, que pone de relieve la profunda polarización del electorado mientras la presidencia de Emmanuel Macron se acerca a su fin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El líder de la izquierda francés Jean-Luc Mélenchon aparece como el rival más probable de la candidata de extrema derecha Marine Le Pen en la segunda vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales del próximo año, según un sondeo publicado el lunes, que pone de relieve la profunda polarización del electorado mientras la presidencia de Emmanuel Macron se acerca a su fin. Mélenchon, candidato del partido de izquierda Francia Insumisa (LFI, por sus siglas en francés), pasaría a la segunda vuelta en al menos tres de los cinco escenarios analizados, mientras que en un cuarto empataría en el segundo puesto. Según el sondeo de Toluna Harris Interactive para M6 y RTL, Le Pen lo derrotaría con facilidad en una segunda vuelta. Los resultados son desalentadores para los candidatos centristas franceses, que tienen dificultades para conectar con un electorado cada vez más polarizado. Al acercarse el final del segundo y último mandato de Macron, el impopular presidente deja tras de sí un centro político debilitado y una economía frágil, lo que abre espacio a partidos de posiciones más duras, como LFI y Reagrupamiento Nacional, la formación de Le Pen. "El riesgo de que la señora Le Pen y el señor Mélenchon se enfrenten en la segunda vuelta es real y grave", dijo el lunes a periodistas el candidato centrista Édouard Philippe. Mélenchon obtendría alrededor de entre el 16% y el 17% en la primera vuelta, mientras que Le Pen lograría entre el 35% y el 38% de los votos. En una segunda vuelta entre ambos, Le Pen se impondría con el 64%. Mélenchon ya se presentó tres veces a las elecciones presidenciales —en 2012, 2017 y 2022—, pero nunca ha logrado pasar a la segunda vuelta.

item.title: Guardians' Jo Adell embraces reunion in encounter vs. Angels
item.description: Jo Adell had the perfect role model during his six-plus seasons with the Los Angeles Angels.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jo Adell had the perfect role model during his six-plus seasons with the Los Angeles Angels. Now that he's with the Cleveland Guardians, he's putting many of his lessons learned from three-time American League MVP Mike Trout to good use. Adell will face his former teammate for the first time since the Angels traded him to the Guardians on Aug. 3, likely starting in right field when Cleveland opens a three-game series on Monday night in Anaheim, Calif. "He's unbelievable at setting up at-bats and getting his pitch," Adell said of Trout. "Watching him just really destroy those pitches and really set the pitcher up to be able to get them and not miss them. ... I had front-row seats for a while." Adell has 17 RBIs through his first 17 games with the Guardians, who have won four games in a row to pull even with the Texas Rangers in the chase for the final wild-card berth in the American League. "Obviously, it's my first time being traded, but coming in, the focus was just about how to put wins up and to be yourself, and they made that crystal clear when I got here," Adell said. "My focus is to help this team and drive some runs in when I get the opportunity, and things have been good so far." Left-hander Parker Messick (9-8, 2.54 ERA) will start for the Guardians on Monday. Messick comes in with the third-best ERA in the American League behind Cam Schlittler (2.16) of the New York Yankees and Dylan Cease (2.37) of the Toronto Blue Jays. Messick has suffered from a lack of run support at times, including in his past two starts. He held the Detroit Tigers to two runs over 5 2/3 innings on Aug. 13, but the Guardians were blanked 3-0. Messick surrendered one run over 6 2/3 innings last Wednesday against the San Francisco Giants, but again Cleveland couldn't muster any runs and lost 1-0. "Anytime you're not scoring runs, it's very frustrating, especially when your pitchers are out there dominating," Guardians catcher Austin Hedges said. "We only gave up one run (against the Giants). Obviously, we expect to win those games." Messick made his only start against the Angels on May 13 and earned the win after limiting them to two runs and four hits in 5 2/3 innings of a 4-2 victory in Cleveland. The Angels are returning home after going 3-3 on a six-game road trip through Texas. Los Angeles had a chance to win a second straight road series for the first time since last year but lost 5-3 to the Rangers on Sunday. Angels left-hander Yusei Kikuchi struggled in his return from a nearly four-month absence due to shoulder problems, giving up five runs over five innings. The Angels will send rookie right-hander George Klassen to the mound against Cleveland on Monday. Klassen (2-1, 3.74 ERA) has made five MLB starts this season and three in a row since his most recent recall from the minors on Aug. 7. He was nearly unhittable in his most recent outing Tuesday against the Houston Astros, allowing just one hit over seven scoreless innings in a 3-1 win. "That was some of the best stuff we've seen all year," Angels manager Kurt Suzuki said. "Attacking with his fastball and pretty nasty sliders, but I think it was more commanding the zone, getting ahead and really just on the attack. He didn't make it too complicated, knew what he did best and went after them." --Field Level Media

item.title: Cobre se fortalece al disparar las compras el metal destinado a salir de la LME

item.dc:creator: Pratima Desai
item.content:encoded: Los precios del cobre subían el lunes, ya que el aumento de órdenes canceladas o del metal destinado a la entrega en la Bolsa de Metales de Londres (LME), desencadenó una oleada de compras, mientras que la depreciación del dólar reforzaba el optimismo respecto a los metales industriales cotizados en el billete verde. * El cobre de referencia en la LME ganaba un 0,2%, a 14.240 dólares por tonelada. Los precios de este metal, utilizado en los sectores de la energía y la construcción, alcanzaron los 14.396 dólares la semana pasada, el nivel más alto desde el máximo de 14.527,5 dólares registrado en enero. * Las cancelaciones están ocurriendo sobre todo en almacenes registrados en la LME en Estados Unidos y Asia —en zonas de libre comercio— y es probable que se entreguen a la Comex o a operadores y consumidores dentro de Estados Unidos, según fuentes del sector. * Los operadores y productores llevan enviando cobre a Estados Unidos desde que el presidente Donald Trump planteó la posibilidad de gravar las importaciones en febrero del año pasado. Las existencias de cobre de la Comex están en picos históricos de 742.778 toneladas cortas (673.836 toneladas métricas). * El zinc sumaba un 0,4%, a 3.838 dólares por tonelada, tras haber tocado 3.850 dólares, su nivel más alto desde junio de 2022, por preocupaciones por la escasez fuera de China, donde las existencias en almacenes autorizados por la Bolsa de Futuros de Shanghái se han más que duplicado este año . * "Una distorsión en la que tanto la oferta como la demanda se están reduciendo hace que el mercado parezca más ajustado de lo que justificaría el débil consumo", señaló en una nota Tom Price, analista de Panmure Liberum. * En otros metales básicos, el aluminio bajaba un 0,1%, a 3.233 dólares la tonelada; el plomo mejoraba un 0,4%, a 1.906 dólares; el estaño ganaba un 0,2%, a 56.000 dólares; y el níquel avanzaba un 0,1%, a 17.080 dólares.

item.title: Trump-linked RUM Group signs $13.7 billion AI deal with US-based cloud client
item.description: RUM Group , which hosts U.S. President Donald Trump's Truth Social platform, said on Monday it has signed a contract with an unnamed U.S.-based cloud customer worth about $13.7 billion to supply AI chips.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: RUM Group (RUM.O) , which hosts U.S. President Donald Trump's Truth Social platform, said on Monday it has signed a contract with an unnamed U.S.-based cloud customer worth about $13.7 billion to supply AI chips. Shares of RUM Group rose more than 8% in premarket trading. Here are some details: Rumble [USN:L4N42P1W3 TEXT:"started operating as RUM Group"] in June after closing its acquisition of German AI cloud company Northern Data, creating a new AI-infrastructure business as it seeks to capitalize on booming AI compute demand. Under the deal, the customer will get access to GPUs and related services from RUM Group's Maysville, Georgia site, which is currently under development. RUM Group said it is giving the unnamed customer the option to buy around 51 million shares of its stock for just one cent each, according to a regulatory filing . The option will become available to the customer gradually over six years, as the client fulfills the purchase agreements. The customer will buy $13.7 billion in GPU services over six years in three parts, with the last instalment contingent on a delivery date approved by the client. RUM Group did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment about the customer. The company said it currently lacks the necessary funds and plans to raise capital through debt or equity to fulfill this contract.

item.title: India seize control of Colombo test after Jurel hundred
item.description: Dhruv Jurel's unbeaten 115 powered India to a commanding 503-9 before they declared late on day two of the second and final test against Sri Lanka on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dhruv Jurel's unbeaten 115 powered India to a commanding 503-9 before they declared late on day two of the second and final test against Sri Lanka on Monday. Rain and bad light meant India could bowl only three overs, which proved enough to prise out Lahiru Udara and nightwatchman Prabath Jayasuriya and restrict Sri Lanka to eight for two, still 495 runs behind. India took control after a resilient lower-order batting display led by Jurel's second test hundred, an innings studded with nine fours and two sixes. India had resumed at 300-5 at the Sinhalese Sports Club Ground, with Rishabh Pant due back after retiring hurt on Sunday following a forearm blow. Seamer Asitha Fernando (4-106) struck in the second over, removing Saransh Jain for six, but the collapse Sri Lanka craved never materialised. Pant joined Jurel to add 112 for the seventh wicket and tighten India's grip. Bruised but undeterred, Pant reached a combative fifty before lunch and departed soon after for 63, stepping out to Nuwantha Keshara and miscuing to long-off. Manav Suthar fell soon after, yet Jurel held firm as India's advantage swelled until rain again forced the players from the field. Jurel lingered on 99 before completing his century with a risky single -- tapping Fernando to mid-off and diving home as a direct hit would have dismissed him. Rising to his feet, he dusted himself off and embraced his partner Mohammed Siraj. Liberated by the milestone, Jurel launched Fernando for six over long-on and, in the seamer's next over, pulled another into the stands. India struck with the ball when Yashasvi Jaiswal flew to his right at third slip to take a catch and dismiss Udara. The deteriorating light forced India to introduce spin, and Suthar struck in his first over by trapping Jayasuriya LBW. Jaiswal and Sri Lanka's Fernando were fined 25% of their match fees and received one demerit point each for their on-field altercation on Sunday.

item.title: Segunda cosecha de maíz en centro-sur de Brasil alcanza el 92%, según AgRural
item.description: Los agricultores del centro-sur de Brasil habían cosechado el 92% de su segunda cosecha de maíz de 2026 hasta el jueves pasado, informó el lunes la consultora agroindustrial AgRural, lo que supone un aumento respecto al 85% de la semana anterior, aunque por debajo del 98% registrado un año antes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los agricultores del centro-sur de Brasil habían cosechado el 92% de su segunda cosecha de maíz de 2026 hasta el jueves pasado, informó el lunes la consultora agroindustrial AgRural, lo que supone un aumento respecto al 85% de la semana anterior, aunque por debajo del 98% registrado un año antes. Las labores de campo han concluido en el estado de Mato Grosso y están a punto de finalizar en Goiás y Minas Gerais, según la consultora. En Paraná la cosecha se aceleró, pero la humedad excesiva siguió ralentizando el avance en comparación con los niveles normales. La siembra de la primera cosecha de maíz de Brasil de la temporada 2026/27 cobró impulso la semana pasada, con un 2% de la superficie estimada de la región centro-sur sembrada hasta el jueves, frente al 0,3% de la semana anterior, según AgRural. No obstante, el ritmo se mantuvo por debajo del 3,2% registrado en el mismo momento del año anterior. Las condiciones de humedad siguen limitando los trabajos en el campo en el estado de Rio Grande do Sul, mientras que los agricultores de Paraná y Santa Catarina ya han comenzado a sembrar, añadió la consultora.

item.title: British city's toilet redevelopment is not exclusively for squat facilities
item.description: Content warning: The screenshot contains language that some find offensive.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Content warning: The screenshot contains language that some find offensive. An English council’s £1 million ($1.363 million) expenditure on new public toilets has been misrepresented online as only covering the cost of squat-style facilities. Here are the key details: Some of the online posts making the false implication also suggested that the spending was evidence of corruption inside Cambridge City Council. A Cambridge City Council spokesperson told Reuters that it spent £1.026 million to redevelop a block of toilets in the city centre, describing the project as “effectively the construction” of a new facility. The Silver Street facility has 13 different toilets, including three new squat-style toilets, “favoured by some international visitors,” the spokesperson said. There are also six seated toilets, three urinals and an accessible seated toilet. Silver Street Bridge is a hot spot for international tourists, according to a council press release . Verdict: Missing context. There are 13 new toilets in the redeveloped Cambridge facilities, only three of which are squat-style toilets.

item.title: Mexico inflation accelerates in early August
item.description: Mexico's 12-month inflation rate accelerated in early August, data from national statistics agency INEGI showed on Monday, while core inflation remained persistent.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mexico's 12-month inflation rate accelerated in early August, data from national statistics agency INEGI showed on Monday, while core inflation remained persistent. Annual inflation in Latin America's second-largest economy reached 3.26% in the first half of August, INEGI said, up from 3.10% a month earlier, though still within the Bank of Mexico's target range of 3%, plus or minus one percentage point. On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.10% in the period, INEGI said. The closely watched core price index, which strips out some volatile food and energy prices, rose 3.93% in the 12 months through early August, and climbed 0.08% compared with the first half of July.

item.title: US Treasury to broaden scope of secondary sanctions on Iran, source says
item.description: The Trump administration is seeking to increase economic pressure on Tehran.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Treasury is expected on Monday to broaden the scope of secondary sanctions it can impose on entities and countries that maintain business ties with Iran as the Trump administration seeks to increase economic pressure on Tehran, a source familiar with the plans told Reuters. The action is aimed at giving a final warning to countries to sever their business ties with Iran in an effort to force an end to the nearly six-month conflict that has bottled up the Strait of Hormuz and Gulf energy exports, said the source, who spoke on condition of anonymity due to not being authorized to speak publicly about the matter. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is expected to announce more details of the Iran actions in a press conference at 1 p.m. EDT (1700 GMT). The source said Bessent also intended to provide a broader overview of an economic pressure campaign against Iran that he and President Donald Trump have described as an "economic D-Day", and would make it clear to countries that they must side with the U.S. or risk having key companies and entities cut off from the dollar-based financial system. Bessent last week billed the action against Iran as the "[USN:L6N44H0E8 TEXT:"toughest sanctions in history"]," saying that along with the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports, they would reduce the need for new "kinetic" military operations against Iran. The U.S. has maintained sanctions against Iran for decades, most of which have been aimed at curtailing the country's oil revenues, aviation sector, cryptocurrency, procurement of weapons components and other military hardware, and cutting off funding for business enterprises controlled by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, a dominant force in the Iranian economy. The sanctions bar designated entities from the dollar-based financial system, but Iran has been successful in quickly standing up new front companies, other entities and vessel registrations to evade the sanctions. The source familiar with Bessent's plans said the action is likely to reveal additional categories of Iran-related conduct that would be subject to secondary sanctions in the future, making it easier to take action against those facilitating the transactions on behalf of the Iranian government. The source did not specify the activities that could be subject to sanctions, but said that for certain Iranian sectors, any activity, even in a third country, could be subject to secondary sanctions. The Treasury currently approves licenses for transactions in a number of sectors in Iran, including for medicine and medical devices, cultural and arts exchanges and agricultural transactions. A senior administration official said Bessent is expected to warn that any remaining financial lifelines, including through banks and third countries that have tolerated certain activity, must be shut down. The official, who also spoke on condition of anonymity, said the Treasury has "mapped Iran's oil-smuggling and sanctions-evasion network" and will present this information to countries helping Iran evade the sanctions as a warning. IMPACT ON RELATIONS WITH CHINA The Treasury in recent months has sanctioned independent Chinese "teapot" refineries for purchases of Iranian oil and expanded its targeting of the shadow fleet of tankers transporting Iranian oil. A much more powerful tool is the authority to sanction banks in China and other countries that are facilitating transactions with Iran, a step that the Trump administration has so far been unwilling to take amid a delicate trade truce with Beijing. With President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping scheduled to meet in Washington in late September, new sanctions on Chinese banks could sour prospects for extending a deal struck last November to keep Chinese rare earths flowing and cap U.S. tariffs. The U.S. blockade of Iran's ports has already curbed Chinese offers to purchase Iranian crude, [USN:L1N44I07T TEXT:"Reuters reported on Friday"], which may lessen the impact of secondary sanctions on China.

item.title: La AIE no está debatiendo una segunda liberación de reservas estratégicas de petróleo, dice Birol
item.description: La Agencia Internacional de la Energía (AIE) no está debatiendo por el momento una segunda liberación de reservas estratégicas de petróleo, dijo el lunes a Reuters su director ejecutivo, Fatih Birol.
item.dc:creator: Nora Buli
item.content:encoded: La Agencia Internacional de la Energía (AIE) no está debatiendo por el momento una segunda liberación de reservas estratégicas de petróleo, dijo el lunes a Reuters su director ejecutivo, Fatih Birol. "Por el momento, no", respondió Birol al margen de una conferencia sobre energía en Noruega cuando se le preguntó si la agencia estudiaba una segunda liberación de reservas estratégicas. La AIE sigue siempre los mercados "muy, muy de cerca" y aún queda el 80% de las reservas estratégicas tras la liberación de 400 millones de barriles en marzo, añadió Birol. En cuanto al gas, Birol expresó preocupación por los niveles actuales de las reservas europeas, que se situaban en torno al 62%, según la plataforma de transparencia AGSI. La Unión Europea tiene como objetivo elevar el nivel de llenado al 80% para el 1 de diciembre. "Las reservas están por debajo de los promedios históricos y todavía esperamos recibir gas de Oriente Medio, mientras que, al mismo tiempo, (...) Europa se ha comprometido a eliminar las importaciones de gas ruso", afirmó. "Si tenemos un invierno duro en Europa, podríamos afrontar algunas dificultades".

item.title: Coinbase-backed crypto advocacy group endorses 32 US midterm candidates
item.description: The endorsements come as the Clarity Act, the crypto industry's top policy priority, stalls in the Senate amid opposition from some lawmakers.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Lang
item.content:encoded: Stand With Crypto, an advocacy group backed by crypto giant Coinbase (COIN.O) , on Monday endorsed 32 incumbent congressional candidates for the November midterm elections, as the industry cements influence in Washington. The endorsements, first reported by Reuters, come as the Clarity Act, the crypto industry's top policy priority, stalls in the Senate amid opposition from some lawmakers. All the candidates endorsed voted last year to pass the bill out of the House of Representatives, and Stand With Crypto hopes to return those industry-friendly candidates to office. Crypto companies say the legislation would give them long-sought legal clarity. Stand With Crypto's 2026 campaign builds on its 2024 effort, the first cycle that the group was active, Mason Lynaugh, executive director of Stand With Crypto, said in an interview. "In 2024 we were very much proving that the crypto voter is real. In 2026 we're very much showing that we have the organizing capacity and that our advocates are a true voting bloc that can move the needle," said Lynaugh. Coinbase [USN:L1N3AU25A TEXT:"launched Stand With Crypto in 2023"] to jumpstart a grassroots advocacy campaign with the goal of advancing pro-crypto legislation. It aims to influence elections by organizing and mobilizing voters rather than through large campaign expenditures. It says it has more than 3 million registered U.S. "advocates." Stand With Crypto endorsed six congressional candidates in March who are running for reelection. Among the new raft of 32 endorsees are some of the industry's key House allies, including Republicans Tom Emmer, and Bill Huizenga, and Democrats Ritchie Torres and Josh Gottheimer. Several of the 32 are running in competitive races, like Arizona Republican Juan Ciscomani and Pennsylvania Republican Brian Fitzpatrick. "I think we can be the difference maker in some of these," Lynaugh said. The group said it will announce its Senate endorsements closer to Election Day. The crypto industry [USN:L1N4310KM TEXT:"spent $170 million"] supporting congressional candidates during the 2024 elections, many of whom won their races. That helped it score a victory last year when Congress passed the Genius Act, which created rules for dollar-backed crypto tokens called stablecoins, potentially boosting their adoption. The sector has already [USN:L1N43P0YD TEXT:"poured close to $200 million"] into the November midterm elections, underscoring its muscle in Congress. Much of that has been directed through Fairshake, a major super political action committee created to support pro-crypto candidates.

item.title: Líder da extrema esquerda deve chegar ao segundo turno da eleição presidencial na França, aponta pesquisa
item.description: O líder da extrema esquerda francesa, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, é considerado o rival mais provável da candidata da extrema direita, Marine Le Pen, no segundo turno das eleições presidenciais da França do próximo ano, segundo uma pesquisa divulgada nesta segunda-feira, o que ressalta a profunda polarização do eleitorado à medida que a Presidência de Emmanuel Macron chega ao fim.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O líder da extrema esquerda francesa, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, é considerado o rival mais provável da candidata da extrema direita, Marine Le Pen, no segundo turno das eleições presidenciais da França do próximo ano, segundo uma pesquisa divulgada nesta segunda-feira, o que ressalta a profunda polarização do eleitorado à medida que a Presidência de Emmanuel Macron chega ao fim. Mélenchon, candidato do partido de extrema esquerda “França Insubmissa” (LFI), deve chegar ao segundo turno em pelo menos três dos cinco cenários analisados na pesquisa, enquanto empatou em segundo lugar em um quarto cenário. Le Pen deve derrotá-lo facilmente no segundo turno. A pesquisa traz um quadro preocupante para os candidatos centristas da França, que enfrentam dificuldades para alcançar um eleitorado cada vez mais polarizado. À medida que o segundo e último mandato de Macron chega ao fim, o presidente impopular deixa para trás um centro político enfraquecido e uma economia frágil, abrindo espaço para partidos de linha dura, como o LFI e o Reunião Nacional, de Le Pen. “O risco de a Sra. Le Pen e o Sr. Mélenchon se enfrentarem no segundo turno é real e grave”, disse o candidato centrista Edouard Philippe aos repórteres nesta segunda-feira. Estima-se que Mélenchon obtenha cerca de 16% a 17% no primeiro turno, enquanto Le Pen obteria de 35% a 38% dos votos. Le Pen conquistaria 64% dos votos contra Mélenchon no segundo turno. Mélenchon já concorreu três vezes à Presidência, em 2012, 2017 e 2022, mas nunca conseguiu chegar ao segundo turno. (Reportagem de Inti Landauro)

item.title: White Sox, Rangers offer possible playoff preview
item.description: A game between two teams that stand a combined five games over .500 heading into the final week of August would not normally be considered a potential playoff preview.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: A game between two teams that stand a combined five games over .500 heading into the final week of August would not normally be considered a potential playoff preview. But in the parity-ridden American League, the Chicago White Sox and Texas Rangers might be offering a glimpse of a possible division-series duel Monday night when the White Sox host the Rangers in the opener of a three-game series. Jose Urquidy (2-1, 5.06 ERA) is expected to start for the White Sox against the Rangers' Kumar Rocker (4-10, 4.46) in a contest of right-handers. Both teams won the rubber game of a three-game series at home on Sunday afternoon. Tristan Peters hit a walk-off homer in the ninth inning to lift the White Sox to a 2-1 win over the New York Mets, and Cal Quantrill tossed six scoreless innings and earned the victory for the Rangers as they beat the Los Angeles Angels 5-3. The White Sox's second walk-off win of the weekend kept them 3 1/2 games ahead of the Cleveland Guardians atop the AL Central race and continued one of the season's most surprising Cinderella stories. The walk-off win was the 11th of the season for the White Sox, who are 23-20 in one-run games after a combined 47-95 in such contests over the previous three seasons -- a span in which Chicago was 162-324 overall. "It replicates playoff games pretty well with how close they are and how late they are," White Sox rookie outfielder Sam Antonacci said of the one-run wins. "Being able to have a bunch of those under our belt if we are fortunate enough to make the playoffs, that's one of our goals. Just hit the ground running." Chicago (68-62) also is 3 1/2 games ahead of the Rangers and the Houston Astros, the AL West co-leaders, for the second seed in the AL and the final playoff bye. The Guardians, Rangers and Astros are 65-66. The Rangers and Guardians are tied for the final wild-card spot, though there are five teams within 3 1/2 games of them. The win Sunday gave Texas at least a share of first place in the AL West for the first time since July 30 and continued its roller-coaster month. The Rangers won four straight games immediately following the Aug. 3 trade deadline before losing six of eight. Texas then went 4-2 against the Angels and Washington Nationals while allowing just 13 runs during the six-game homestand that ended Sunday. "Could we have played better? Of course," Rangers manager Skip Schumaker said. "I think anybody would say that in that clubhouse. However, the goal is to win each series, and we did that." Urquidy, who would make his first start of the season, earned the win last Wednesday, when he tossed six scoreless innings of bulk relief as the White Sox beat the Chicago Cubs 3-0. The White Sox acquired Urquidy from Pittsburgh before the trade deadline for a minor league pitching prospect, and he is 2-0 with a 2.79 ERA since. Rocker took the defeat Wednesday after allowing two runs over five innings in the Rangers' 6-0 loss to the Nationals. Urquidy is 5-0 with a 2.82 ERA in seven career starts against the Rangers, and Rocker is 2-0 with an 0.00 ERA in two starts against the White Sox spanning 11 innings. Rocker threw six scoreless, one-hit innings against the White Sox on July 21, earning the 10-0 win. --Field Level Media

item.title: China's Xi likely to visit India with big delegation for first time in seven years
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping is likely to attend next month's BRICS summit in New Delhi with a large delegation, three sources said, in what would be his first visit in seven years and a fresh sign of a thaw between the rivals.
item.dc:creator: Saurabh Sharma, Aftab Ahmed
item.content:encoded: Chinese President Xi Jinping is likely to attend next month's BRICS summit in New Delhi with a large delegation, three sources said, in what would be his first visit in seven years and a fresh sign of a thaw between the rivals. India is hosting the September 12 to 13 summit, where Xi's presence would be watched less for the BRICS agenda than for what it signals about Beijing and New Delhi's efforts to stabilise relations after deadly border clashes in 2020. "Chinese officials are busy finalising hotels and security protocols," one of the Indian sources with direct knowledge told Reuters. Last year, Indian [USN:L4N3UH09J TEXT:"Prime Minister Narendra Modi"] visited China for the first time in seven years, but the relationship has only improved gradually. More recently, a fresh border-related dispute triggered sharp diplomatic exchanges between the two sides. Two other Indian sources said Xi was likely to be accompanied by a delegation of about 400 officials, compared with fewer than 200 officials the last time in 2019. Officials from both countries are expected to use the summit to explore ways to expand engagement while managing long-standing differences over the border and regional security issues, the sources added. Xi's final travel plans and agenda for any potential bilateral between India and China are yet to be finalised, the sources said. The Chinese foreign ministry said, "China attaches great importance to and actively participates in BRICS cooperation, and supports India, the current chair, in successfully hosting this year's BRICS summit." "We currently have no information available to provide" about Xi's visit, it said. Xi missed the last BRICS summit in 2025 in Brazil. India's foreign ministry did not comment. INDIA-CHINA BORDER ISSUE The world's two most populous nations, both nuclear powers, share a roughly 3,800-km (2,400-mile), largely undemarcated and disputed border in the Himalayas. Decades of relative peace along the border were shattered by 2020 clashes where 20 Indian and four Chinese soldiers were killed. The incident led to a four-year military standoff before reaching a disengagement pact in October 2024. But on August 12, India said [USN:L4N449091 TEXT:"peace along the border was critical"] to ties after reports that Indian and Chinese army patrols came face-to-face in late July near a remote border. India's National Security Advisor Ajit Doval on Monday started his visit to Beijing to meet Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi to hold talks on the boundary issue. While India and China remain competitors, U.S. President Donald Trump's trade policies have created one area of convergence, making Xi's attendance a signal that neither side wants external pressure to undermine BRICS. ($1 = 95.7450 Indian rupees)

item.title: Crudo cae a la espera del anuncio de nuevas sanciones de EEUU contra Irán
item.description: Los precios del petróleo caían más de 1 dólar por barril el lunes, ya que los inversores recogían beneficios tras las recientes alzas y esperaban detalles sobre las nuevas sanciones que se espera que Estados Unidos imponga a Irán, lo que podría perturbar aún más el suministro procedente de Oriente Medio.
item.dc:creator: Robert Harvey
item.content:encoded: Los precios del petróleo caían más de 1 dólar por barril el lunes, ya que los inversores recogían beneficios tras las recientes alzas y esperaban detalles sobre las nuevas sanciones que se espera que Estados Unidos imponga a Irán, lo que podría perturbar aún más el suministro procedente de Oriente Medio. * A las 1131 GMT, los futuros del Brent restaban 1,16 dólares, o un 1,23%, a 93,23 dólares el barril, mientras que el West Texas Intermediate en Estados Unidos (WTI) restaba 1,55 dólares, o un 1,78%, a 85,51 dólares. * Ambos contratos registraron la semana pasada su segundo avance semanal consecutivo, con un aumento superior al 5%, en medio del estancamiento de las negociaciones de paz entre Estados Unidos e Irán, limitando los envíos petroleros a través del estrecho de Ormuz, una ruta por la que antes circulaba una quinta parte del suministro mundial. * El secretario del Tesoro estadounidense, Scott Bessent, que tiene previsto celebrar una rueda de prensa a las 1700 GMT, ha amenazado con imponer "las sanciones más duras de la historia" a Irán. El presidente Donald Trump también ha amenazado con imponer sanciones a los socios comerciales de Irán. * "Si se pone en marcha el embargo anunciado, el suministro de la región se reducirá", dijo Tamas Varga, analista de PVM, añadiendo que es probable que Washington endurezca su bloqueo naval contra las exportaciones de crudo iraníes y que Irán tome represalias contra instalaciones petroleras en Oriente Medio. * Irán ha condenado los planes estadounidenses de anunciar nuevas sanciones y el presidente Masoud Pezeshkian ha abogado por una solución diplomática. El jefe del ejército de Pakistán se encontraba el lunes de visita en Teherán para mantener conversaciones de mediación. * Menos de 20 buques de mercancías transitaron por el estrecho de Ormuz durante el fin de semana, según datos de transporte marítimo publicados el lunes, ya que los bloqueos iraní y estadounidense restringen el tráfico a través de este punto estratégico para los envíos de energía. * Sin embargo, Irán ha concedido permiso para que varios petroleros iraquíes atraviesen el estrecho tras repetidas peticiones de Bagdad, según informó el sábado la agencia estatal de noticias iraní IRNA.

item.title: Mexico's economy blooms in Q2, fastest growing pace since 2022
item.description: Mexico's economy rebounded in the second quarter from the previous three-month period, national statistics agency INEGI said on Monday, posting its strongest expansion since early 2022.
item.dc:creator: Aida Pelaez-fernandez
item.content:encoded: Mexico's economy rebounded in the second quarter from the previous three-month period, national statistics agency INEGI said on Monday, posting its strongest expansion since early 2022. Latin America's second-largest economy expanded 1.4% and rebounded from a revised [USN:L1N41Z0E3 TEXT:"0.3% contraction"] in the first quarter. All three main sectors tracked by INEGI posted growth during the period, with primary activities - which include farming, fishing and mining - leading the way with a 2.4% expansion. Growth, however, was slightly below INEGI's [USN:L1N43W0RC TEXT:"preliminary estimate"] of 1.5% published last month. In annual terms, Latin America's second-largest economy expanded 2.1% in the second quarter, the statistics agency said. In a separate report, INEGI said that [USN:AQN2MG8KY TEXT:"in June alone"] Mexico's economy contracted slightly 0.1% compared with the prior month, but registered a 2.8% expansion from June of 2025. STUBBORN INFLATION Official data also showed that Mexico's 12-month [USN:L1N44L0EG TEXT:"inflation rate accelerated"] in early August, reaching 3.26%, up from 3.10% a month earlier. Though the rate is still within the Bank of Mexico's target range of 3%, plus or minus one percentage point, persistent inflation coupled with signs of economic improvement tilt towards a rate hike, despite the bank's recent cautious tone. Banxico, as the central bank is known, [USN:S0N42K04P TEXT:"held its interest rate"] at 6.5% earlier this month and its policymakers were inclined to keep its [USN:L1N44H0O3 TEXT:"benchmark rate unchanged"] for an extended period, minutes of the meeting showed. The closely watched core price index, which strips out some volatile food and energy prices, rose 3.93% in the 12 months through early August, and climbed 0.08% compared with the first half of July.

item.title: Indonésia afirma que número de mortos no terremoto de 15 de agosto chegou a 100
item.description: O número de mortos no terremoto que atingiu o leste da Indonésia chegou a 100 na segunda-feira, informou o chefe da agência de gestão de desastres, enquanto as operações de socorro continuavam pelo décimo dia consecutivo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O número de mortos no terremoto que atingiu o leste da Indonésia chegou a 100 na segunda-feira, informou o chefe da agência de gestão de desastres, enquanto as operações de socorro continuavam pelo décimo dia consecutivo. O terremoto de magnitude 7,7 sacudiu a província de Nusa Tenggara Oriental em 15 de agosto, seguido por milhares de réplicas, danificando mais de 73 mil casas e forçando a retirada de cerca de 180 mil pessoas. O número de mortos chegou a 100 à medida que mais pessoas em tratamento sucumbiram aos ferimentos, disse o chefe da agência de desastres, Suharyanto, em uma coletiva de imprensa, acrescentando que mais de 1.600 pessoas ficaram feridas. As autoridades estavam distribuindo ajuda humanitária por meio de helicópteros, caminhões e motos, de acordo com Suharyanto. O terremoto foi o mais mortal da Indonésia desde 2022, quando um terremoto raso de magnitude 5,6 matou centenas de pessoas em Java Ocidental. A Indonésia, um arquipélago com 290 milhões de habitantes, está localizada no “Anel de Fogo do Pacífico”, uma zona sismicamente ativa onde as placas tectônicas se encontram e terremotos e erupções vulcânicas são frequentes.

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS Wall Street vue en baisse, la géopolitique dans le viseur
item.description: Wall Street est attendue en baisse tandis que les Bourses européennes évoluent en ordre dispersé à mi-séance, les investisseurs hésitant face à la perspective de nouvelles sanctions américaines contre l'Iran, tout en attendant le discours du président de la Fed à Jackson Hole et les résultats de Nvidia.
item.dc:creator: Coralie Lamarque
item.content:encoded: Wall Street est attendue en baisse tandis que les Bourses européennes évoluent en ordre dispersé à mi-séance, les investisseurs hésitant face à la perspective de nouvelles sanctions américaines contre l'Iran, tout en attendant le discours du président de la Fed à Jackson Hole et les résultats de Nvidia. Les futures sur indices new-yorkais signalent une ouverture de Wall Street en baisse de 0,08% pour le Dow Jones (.DJI) , de 0,16% pour le Standard & Poor's-500 (.SPX) et de 0,49% pour le Nasdaq (.IXIC) . À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) perd 0,09% à 8.476,46 points vers 11h53 GMT. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) recule de 0,01% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) prend 0,07%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) cède 0,06%, tandis que le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) progresse de 0,01% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,01%. Le Moyen-Orient continue de retenir l'attention des opérateurs, les États-Unis s'apprêtant à mettre en place des sanctions économiques visant les partenaires commerciaux de l'Iran, dans le cadre de ce qu'ils ont qualifié de "plus grande offensive financière de tous les temps", le secrétaire au Trésor américain Scott Bessent devant tenir une conférence de presse à 17h00 GMT. En parallèle, l'Iran [USN:L6N44L0EU TEXT:"menace"] de saisir les navires ne respectant pas les règles relatives au transit dans le détroit d'Ormuz, parmi d'autres restrictions, selon un message publié sur X par l'Autorité du détroit du golfe Persique (PGSA). Par ailleurs, le discours de Kevin Warsh lors du symposium annuel de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed) à Jackson Hole, dans le Wyoming, sera [USN:L6N44L0DY TEXT:"suivi de près"] cette semaine afin d’y déceler des indices sur la manière dont la banque centrale compte orienter sa politique monétaire dans un contexte de hausse des prix du pétrole et des rendements obligataires. "Nous ne savons plus qui contrôlera en fin de compte la partie longue de la courbe des taux américaine : le Trésor, la Fed ou le marché obligataire lui-même (...) Au vu de la réaction de la semaine dernière à l’annonce du Trésor, c’est toujours le marché qui a le dernier mot", a déclaré Ipek Ozkardeskaya, analyste senior chez Swissquote Bank. "Le rassemblement de Jackson Hole apportera un peu de clarté sur la manière dont la Fed s’inscrira dans ce contexte", a-t-elle ajouté. Selon les données LSEG, les marchés anticipent pleinement une hausse des taux d’intérêt de 25 points de base d’ici fin 2026. Dans le même temps, les investisseurs se préparent pour les résultats du géant américain des puces Nvidia (NVDA.O) , attendus mercredi, sachant que tout signe de ralentissement de croissance de la société la plus valorisée au monde pourrait raviver des inquiétudes sur l'intelligence artificielle (IA). LES VALEURS À SUIVRE À WALL STREET [USN:L8N44L0KB] VALEURS EN EUROPE Dans le sillage des inquiétudes quant à de nouvelles sanctions américaines attendues contre l'Iran, le compartiment des énergies fossiles (.SXEP) recule de 0,9%, affichant la pire performance sectorielle à mi-séance. Le secteur automobile plombe le CAC 40, Stellantis et Renault (RENA.PA) perdant respectivement 2,2% et 1,6%. PÉTROLE Les cours pétroliers sont en recul, alors que les investisseurs ont pris leurs bénéfices après les récentes hausses et attendent des précisions sur les nouvelles sanctions américaines attendues contre l'Iran, qui pourraient perturber davantage les approvisionnements en provenance du Moyen-Orient. "Si l'embargo annoncé venait à être mis en place, l'offre de pétrole en provenance de la région diminuerait", a déclaré Tamas Varga, analyste chez PVM, ajoutant que les États-Unis renforceraient probablement leur blocus naval contre les exportations de pétrole iraniennes et que l'Iran pourrait riposter par de nouvelles frappes contre des installations pétrolières au Moyen-Orient. Le Brent perd 1,53% à 92,95 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) cède 2,12% à 85,21 dollars. Les deux principaux contrats ont enregistré la semaine dernière une deuxième hausse hebdomadaire consécutive, progressant de plus de 5%, alors que les négociations de paix entre les États-Unis et l’Iran restaient au point mort. TAUX En attendant les déclarations de Kevin Warsh à Jackson Hole, le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans perd 2,0 points de base à 4,7180%. Le deux ans abandonne quant à lui 0,4 point de base à 4,2380%. En Europe, le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans reste stable à 3,2563%, tandis que le deux ans grappille 0,5 point de base à 2,8429%. CHANGES L'incertitude géopolitique profite aux valeurs refuge comme le billet vert, les cambistes attendant des précisions sur les sanctions américaines prévues contre l'Iran, en plus de des déclarations du président de la Fed. Le dollar gagne 0,18% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tandis que l'euro perd 0,1% à 1,1667 dollar .
